items.title_zh: 7 岁王子吉格梅·纳姆耶尔·旺楚克 (Jigme Namgyel Wangchuck) 是不丹第一位数字公民
items.title_en: 7-Year-Old Prince Jigme Namgyel Wangchuck Is Bhutan's First Digital Citizen
items.summary_zh: 吉格梅·纳姆耶尔·旺楚克 (Jigme Namgyel Wangchuck) 王子通过使用不丹国家数字身份 (NDI) 移动钱包，成为该国第一位数字公民。
items.summary_en: Prince Jigme Namgyel Wangchuck became the country's first digital citizen by onboarding the Bhutan National Digital Identity (NDI) mobile wallet.

items.title_zh: 观看：这件麻袋做的衣服花费了炸弹，网络震惊
items.title_en: Watch: This Dress Made Of Sacks Costs A Bomb And Internet Is Stunned
items.summary_zh: 我们日常生活中用来储存小麦和大米的麻袋现在被用来制作衣服。
items.summary_en: The sacks which we use in our daily household, to store wheat and rice, are now used to make dresses.

items.title_zh: Ravichandran Ashwin 对“男孩只需要一件事”趋势的回应在推特上引起热议
items.title_en: Ravichandran Ashwin’s Response To ‘Boys Only Need One Thing’ Trend Has Twitter Talking
items.summary_zh: Ravichandran Ashwin 似乎全神贯注于边境加瓦斯卡奖杯。
items.summary_en: Ravichandran Ashwin seemed all focused on the Border Gavaskar Trophy.
